text:
alex: Heads-up: starting the cohort-cascade unwind for cascade_cohort_v2 at 23:00 UTC in the change window. plan: enable 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m steps. deploybot: scheduled deploy queued for 2024-05-14T23:00:00Z for service 'llm-router' :white_check_mark:
maria: quick q — are we pinning model v3.2.1 for the window? or letting routing fallback to v3.2.0 on error?
deploybot: deploy id 20240514-llmroute-042, flagset update queued: cascade_cohort_v2: 0%->1% (step1). autoswap fallback configured to v3.2.0 if latency spike or error rate > 2%.
jamal: rollback trigger: if p95 latency increases > 200ms OR error-rate delta > 1.5% sustained for 5m. also watch tokens/sec drop.
olive: adding a line to release notes: "cascade_cohort_v2 gradual unwind to evaluate routing stability; pinned model v3.2.1 for cohort exposures; fallback to v3.2.0". cc @maria for review :memo:
maria: ack, adding decision that we keep a soft-pin for 10m after each ramp step (so we don't oscillate). will update the notes.
sre_bot: monitor checkpoints set: latency_p95, op_error_rate, kv_cache_miss_rate. alert policy: page on sev1 if p95 > 500ms OR error_rate > 3% for 3m. runbook: https://wiki/internal/ff-rollouts#cascade-unwind
alex: ops checklist (short):
```
- at t+0m set cascade_cohort_v2 = 1%
- wait 10m, verify metrics (p95, errors, tokens/sec, cost-per-token)
- set soft-pin model=3.2.1 for 10m
- t+10m bump to 5% if signals green
- repeat 20% -> 50% with same gating
- abort and drain to 0% on rollback trigger
```
jamal: will run the smoke prompt set after each step. I'll post quick perf snapshots.
olive: change window reminder: 23:00-01:00 UTC. Ops oncall: @jamal, @alex. If anything smells off, fast-disable is `releases toggle set cascade_cohort_v2 0% --immediate`.
deploybot: step1 executed: cascade_cohort_v2 = 1% (6831122400). Next scheduled bump in 10m.
maria: noted — I'm standing by to adjust pins if we see token-quality drift. also uploading the quick-eval prompts to the release notes. :thumbsup:
jamal: smoke pass #1: p95 +12ms, errors steady. no regression on quality evals. green to proceed.
sre_bot: telemetry: kv_cache_miss +0.3%, latency_p95 +10ms, error_rate +0.02%. within thresholds.
alex: proceeding to 5% now. I'll call it out when step executes.
deploybot: step2 executed: cascade_cohort_v2 = 5% (6831123000). next bump at +10m.
olive: recording final note: cohort-cascade unwind completed to 50% planned, monitoring continues into cooldown window. release notes draft uploaded.
maria: follow-up: recommend keeping the soft-pin policy in config for future fast rollbacks.
alex: thanks everyone — will close thread after cooldown. :party_popper:
